01 · About

About the project

Appetite is a local food delivery app where you build your own rolls and wraps. The goal: make ordering a custom meal quick and easy, with a clean, simple interface.

      05 · Research

      Contextual enquiry

      We studied a local roll outlet using five research models. Scroll to walk through them.

          Sequence model

          Who does what

          The team

          BossChefAssistant chef 1Assistant chef 2CashierCleanerDelivery in-charge

          Boss
          Supervises the staff and restocks raw materials.

          In the kitchen

          Chef
          Makes the veg and non-veg fillings, with separate gloves for each.
          Assistant chef 1
          Makes the parathas and passes them to assistant chef 2.
          Assistant chef 2
          Has the sauces and fillings, hands finished orders to the cashier and checks for expired stock.

          At the counter

          Cashier
          Takes orders, bills customers and gives change.
          Delivery in-charge
          Makes sure orders reach customers and get paid for.

          Clean-up

          Cleaner
          Cleans up after the team and disposes of waste.

          ⚡ BreakdownSome items sell more than others, so unused stock goes to waste and costs money.

          Artifact model

          What they use every day

          Kitchen & counter

          Raw materials

          Daily use approx. kg

          Flour 24 kg
          Chicken 20 kg
          Cottage cheese 10 kg
          Mustard sauce 4 kg
          Red sauce 4 kg

          Workflow model

          How the team works

          Step 1

          The team works together to get the product to the customer. The boss isn't directly involved, so he's shown faded.

          Step 2

          The goal: hand over a quality product and get paid.

          Physical model

          The space

          A compact outlet among similar food stalls. A shake and mocktail shop next door lets students grab a drink with their roll.

          Cultural model

          How people feel

          • Staff are motivated and often improvise to keep orders moving.
          • They talk little and stay focused. The cashier is loud, clear and attentive.
          • Heavy workloads have made them fast and efficient. The supervisor checks quality.
          • Staff are happy with their pay.

          Almost every customer is happy and would order again.

            Onboarding

              Home screen

              A quick guide. Tap a dot on the phone or an item below.

                03

                The signature feature

                Create your own roll

                Pick every ingredient yourself. Simple controls keep it quick, and a meal you built feels personal.

                Try it: pick a base, add fillings and sauces, then add your roll to the cart.

                04

                Nutrition facts

                Every item on the menu comes with its nutrition facts, so health-conscious eaters can choose with confidence.

                05

                New recipes

                Students nearby share new recipes every week. Find combos and discounts, or post your own.

                06

                Cart & checkout

                Review, edit and place your order in a few quick steps.
